title: kate-core: split, activate, and list the views from the workspace
summary: Workspace gains split, activate, and views_in_order. They call the SplitTree methods split_after, activate, and views_in_order that exist with a dead_code attribute. activate also sets active_view. The window draws the tab bar and the panes from these.

lane.reason: A Cursor cloud agent codes this packet. workspace.rs is a 3,500-line file and the change touches its command dispatch. The Linux VM builds and tests kate-core. The owner Mac stays free for the window.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add the three public methods to the first impl Workspace block. split calls self.layout.split_after(view, axis). activate calls self.layout.activate(view); when it returns true, set self.active_view = Some(view). views_in_order returns self.layout.views_in_order(). Remove the #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))] attribute from SplitTree::activate, split_after, and views_in_order. Their bodies stay unchanged. The test workspace_splits_and_activates_views opens three untitled documents, asserts views_in_order lists them in creation order, splits after the first view horizontally, asserts the layout is a Split whose first leaf holds one tab, activates the first view, and asserts active_view is that view and activate of ViewId::default() is false. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::workspace_splits_and_activates_views
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because Workspace::split does not exist. After the change the three methods drive the SplitTree and active_view follows activate.
